highlights: Designed and integrated MCP-driven agentic workflows into the engineering lifecycle, adopted by 20+ teams; reduced research and debugging effort by approximately 95% while improving accuracy.

Contributed to Build Agent in ServiceNow Studio, elevating App Engine with agentic workflows for AI-assisted application creation, flow generation, and tool orchestration across 35+ metadata types and 11 domains; built on the planning pattern (think first, then execute) and led its metadata-aware, multi-model (Claude Opus 4.6 default; Now LLM + Claude on Bedrock), self-healing agentic architecture.

Founded the Agentic Developer Platform (ADP), a multi-team bootstrap and governance infrastructure for Claude Code, MCP servers, agents, and skills; built in 4 weeks on a multi-agent orchestration pattern and rolled out to 7 pilot squads with 20+ skills, 20+ agents, and 20+ teams.

ADP outcomes: reduced case task resolution time by 90%, cut automation development from days to hours even on legacy codebases, lifted legacy test coverage from 20% to 90%, and reduced external defects by 90%.

Led the ALA Release Lifecycle Documentation Agent and App Summary Agent (Now Assist for Creator): automated delta analysis, human-readable release notes, and CAB-ready deployment manifests on the REAct agentic framework: documentation time from hours to a single click; ships as the Release lifecycle documentation agent in Now Assist for Creator.
Architected scalable React/TypeScript systems powering low-code tools including Table Builder and Workspace Builder; API and template contributions to the App Template Framework (ATFr).

Lead a 9-person engineering team as tech lead: mentoring, technical hiring, and high-bar architectural reviews; ran cross-team onboarding sessions enabling teams to set up ADP skills, agents, rules, and MCP servers in a single session.
Drive performance optimization and WCAG/ARIA accessibility compliance; established enterprise testing strategy with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
Contributed to frontend infrastructure and global engineering initiatives; identified codebase problem areas, drove improvement proposals, interviewed candidates, and mentored junior engineers.
Led the Actions Team frontend, migrating the application from Angular to React and cutting page load time in half.
Delivered the Actions feature and management dashboard; raised accessibility compliance from 80% to 95% for a broad user base.
Built maintainable, scalable, and testable features; mentored junior developers and reviewed code.
Built products and services using JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Meteor, and REST APIs.
